Methodology / Automotive market

Automotive GEO methodology: measuring AI recommendations

Alexey YakovlevUpdated 8 November 2026

Separate recommendations of a car make or model from recommendations of the specific dealer, importer, workshop and motorcycle dealership. That is the prerequisite for measuring business visibility.

Discuss your projectSee the industry hub

The automotive baseline links a buyer intent to a verifiable offer and the actual recommended provider. A model mention does not count as a dealer mention.

Unit of analysis and a fixed prompt set

Record exact unbranded prompts, models or AI interfaces, geography, dates and the rule for identifying the business. A car brand mentioned without the seller does not raise dealer BMR.

BMR is the proportion of received AI answers containing the tracked company name. Report missing answers separately; keep the baseline prompt set stable when adding new market segments.

Build the intent × evidence matrix

Segment dealer prompts by new versus used cars, trims, trade-in and financing. Segment imports by contracting role, origin, customs, recycling fees and vehicle passport. Segment repair by fault, vehicle type and work order.

Commercial vehicles require payload and application data; motorcycles require accurate specifications, stock and service terms. A generic 'best automotive company' prompt is not an adequate diagnostic.

Review answers for factual accuracy

For each answer store the prompt, model and date, named providers, recommendation context, cited evidence and contradictions.

  • A car make is mentioned but the dealership is not: dealer BMR does not increase.
  • A dealer is named with an incomplete price: verify finance and add-on conditions.
  • A workshop is recommended for unverified specialist repairs: flag the claim.
  • An importer is assigned a fixed fee without sufficient conditions: verify the current applicable rules.
  • A motorcycle warranty is asserted without the applicable sales terms: verify the dealer and manufacturer documents.

Publish verifiable decision evidence

Create readable offer and service pages with exact model, trim, terms, repair scope and motorcycle model information. The date and source of changing claims matter as much as the claim itself.

Russian consumer guidance from 2026 covers car-sale add-ons and the current repair paperwork framework. Recheck applicability instead of relying on outdated summaries.

Repeat the baseline without changing its meaning

Measure the fixed sample monthly, document missing answers and measure new prompts in a separate expanded sample. Track sound recommendations as well as raw mentions.

For GAEO's guaranteed plan, the contractual BMR targets from the baseline are +5, +10 and +15 percentage points for months 1, 2 and 3 respectively. The contract defines the measurement conditions.

Worked verification scenario

Suppose an AI answer recommends a dealer and a quoted price. Verify model, trim, date, payment mode and extras against the actual offer. A price valid only with a credit package needs an explicit qualification.

This is a hypothetical procedure, not evidence of an actual client measurement.

Frequently asked questions

Does a car manufacturer's mention count towards a dealer's BMR?+
No. Count the actual dealership name according to the predefined identification rules.
Can results from two dealerships be compared?+
Yes, with a matched prompt set, geography, AI models and counting rules, while accounting for different inventory and vehicle models.
What if AI quotes the wrong import cost?+
Check the source date and vehicle characteristics, repair the controlled public information and repeat the original query.
